spot.html_text: (1) If Fermat’s last theorem were false, then no argument for it would be sound. (2) If Fermat’s last theorem were false, then Andrew Wiles would deserve eternal fame. (3) If intuitionistic logic were correct, then the Law of Excluded Middle would fail. (4) If intuitionistic logic were correct, then the Law of Excluded Middle would hold.
